# Independent owned-consumer composition

This source is separate from the new Go consumer implementation. It composes
approved core reference states with exact public Set64/65 admission/career bytes,
then uses the old independent Python manifest/condition oracles. Synthetic
transfer/finality/cutoff values remain conditional, not claims of live chain
truth. No private wallet data, Go outputs, network or proof-of-work is used.

The original birth assignment and historical career row bytes stay unchanged.
The recipient sees those prior corners. Reacquisition has a different state ID.
Only the unawarded v1 fighter enters the C1 modeled cutoff; v2 awarded history is
never forced into unsupported later matchmaking.

The generator verifies a root-approved SHA-pinned execution lock and the exact
five-source inventory, then every locked public input, before importing any
model. It requires --execute and writes the output exclusively. Input intake and
its adopted-contract extension are retained separately. Python3.14 first run,
Python3.9 fresh output and repository-only portable reproduction will be recorded
once root approves execution. No such run has happened yet.

The snapshot case demonstrates closed bytes and complete selected-ID partition.
It does not claim that the modeled public-core frontiers correspond to live
headers or that this reference creates an authenticated source capability.
Concrete store/lifetime/cutoff authority requires separate runtime qualification.

The namespace successor derives the inherited entry namespace from network, genesis and account authority. The old literal is used only as a refusal witness. Both entry pins are validated before any composed output is written.
